headline: Divided Fronts See Fresh Strategic Exchanges
war_summary: The latest returns keep Fisherman’s Row at the head of the communiqué: four strategic-base events landed in the past two hours, and its ledger now stands four Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral base, a changed balance from the previous edition. Lykos Isle also saw two fresh events, with five Warden bases and two Colonial, while its 24-hour total has eased to 20. Tempest Island remains divided seven Colonial to two Warden, with four events in six hours and 14 across the day. Farranac Coast is still an active, evenly contested theater by activity, recording 15 events in 24 hours and holding its four-to-seven split. Deadlands remains divided four Warden to seven Colonial, with five daily events concentrated at The Salt March. Godcrofts has recorded eight events in the day, down from the prior report’s figure, but remains wholly Warden-held. Behind these ledgers, Weathered Expanse, Kings Cage, Linn’s Mercy, Loch Mor, and Marban Hollow show heavy or accelerating casualty activity without fresh base events, marking them as fronts to watch rather than confirmed strategic shifts.
